authorisation: NOT AUTHORISED. Neither arm may run under this amendment.

amends.reason: execution environment identity was not sufficiently pinned in V1; one provenance field was incorrectly recomputed from live ISAAC_SLOT state rather than preserved as a historical freeze-time fact
unchanged_by_this_amendment: the route and the frozen polyline
the initial pose and start yaw
the goal and the goal tolerance
cruise speed and every velocity limit

basis.not_derived_from: any live reading of the machine. Re-running the preflight, repairing the GPU, or rebooting cannot change this block

PROVENANCE_FIELD_REGRESSION_V1.old_computation: bool(isaac_slot['ISAAC_SLOT'] == 'BLOCKED'), evaluated at preflight run time in scripts/preflight_terminal_approach_intervention.py
PROVENANCE_FIELD_REGRESSION_V1.why_it_is_invalid: it is a statement about the design freeze whose value is a function of the machine's present state. Repairing the GPU rewrote the past: the same field, describing the same historical moment, changed from true to false because a driver was reloaded. A provenance field that live state can flip records nothing, and is worse than an absent field because it reads as evidence

post_reboot_source.note: the working-tree artefact regenerated after the GPU was repaired

PROVENANCE_FIELD_REGRESSION_V1.correction_introduced_in_v2: design_freeze, above: an immutable assertion read from the artefact frozen at 09:33 UTC and verified by hash against a pinned commit, separated from live execution readiness which is recomputed every run
PROVENANCE_FIELD_REGRESSION_V1.old_artefacts_note: the committed pre-reboot artefact is left exactly as it was. The field is deprecated for interpretation, not erased from history, and the live emitter no longer produces it as a boolean

checks.detail: the frozen artefact is valid JSON

EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_V2.what_it_is_for: an arm pair differing in one factor is evidence only if everything else that can change the trajectory was the same. These are the fields that can
EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_V2.why_the_split_is_three_ways_and_not_two: contract-critical fields are frozen here and must still hold when an arm runs. Pairwise-critical fields must match between the arms but cannot be frozen here, because their correct value does not exist yet: the commit carrying this amendment is not known to it, and the boot the arms will run under has not happened. Observational fields locate a run without defining it; requiring them to match would make every run unrepeatable by construction
EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_V2.boot_id_is_the_no_reboot_instrument: session.boot_id is redrawn by the kernel on every boot. Two arms sharing one did not have a reboot between them; two arms that do not share one did, whatever the kernel release says. Kernel release alone would not detect a reboot into the same kernel

amendment_binding.rule: a per-arm capture must record the sha256 of this amendment file and it must equal the amendment in force
amendment_binding.why_it_is_not_a_field_inside_this_payloa: a file cannot contain its own hash. The binding is checked from outside by the per-arm guard, not asserted from within

KERNEL_UPDATE_POLICY.why: a staged kernel update cannot alter the running kernel without a reboot, so holding kernel packages protects against nothing this experiment is exposed to. Recording and comparing what actually ran is the protection that discriminates
KERNEL_UPDATE_POLICY.if_the_machine_reboots_between_arms: ENVIRONMENT_EQUIVALENCE = FAIL and the comparison is refused until environment identity is re-established under a new amendment

NVIDIA_HOLD_POLICY.why: unattended-upgrades moved this driver once already, at 06:24 on the day of the design freeze. The holds are what stop it moving between Arm A and Arm B, which would make the one-factor claim false without making it look false
NVIDIA_HOLD_POLICY.hold_list_formatting_note: the frozen list carries explicit :amd64 qualifiers where apt-mark showhold prints bare names for the native architecture. The sets are identical once normalised; a count of 22 is the check that matters

WORKING_TREE_POLICY.allow_list_semantics: deny by default. A path is tolerated only if it is on the explicit allow-list; anything else makes the state dirty and fails the gate
WORKING_TREE_POLICY.why_not_declared_here: the arms' output paths are defined by the execution manifest, which is a later tranche. Inventing them now would freeze a guess
WORKING_TREE_POLICY.preflight_artefact_disposition: gates/BO10/intervention_execution_preflight_20260911.json is intended scientific evidence and is committed with this amendment, so the tree is clean rather than tolerated-dirty at arm execution

forbidden: repairing one arm and comparing anyway
silently re-running only the less favourable arm
reporting the comparison with a caveat instead of refusing it
ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH_POLICY.a_valid_retry_requires: the preregistered retry policy already frozen in the V1 preflight, or a new amendment. It does not require a different analysis of two runs that were not comparable

the_cuda_probe_establishes: CUDA context creation succeeds in the Isaac Python environment
approximately 15 GB of GPU memory was free at probe time
it_does_not_establish: that full Isaac Sim rendering succeeds
that both intervention arms will execute
ISAAC_SLOT_CLAIM_BOUNDARY.status_of_ISAAC_SLOT_AVAILABLE: an execution-readiness INFERENCE, not proof of a completed Isaac run. Those claims require actual arm execution

ARM_ENVIRONMENT_GUARD.comparison_rule: ENV_A == ENV_B over every equality-critical field
